mvp_definition.source_of_truth: README.md (471 lines) + AGENTS.md (661 lines) + observed route surface in server.ts
mvp_definition.product: REDDY Agent — a browser dashboard over an Express server that runs an iterative Gemini tool-calling agent loop with session memory, a skill/tool registry, a knowledge vault, Google Workspace actions, and a codebase 'purge' utility.

primary_user_journeys.action: Sends a chat message in the cockpit terminal
primary_user_journeys.expected_observable_outcome: POST /api/chat returns {response, session_id} produced by the Gemini agent loop; message + latency appear in the telemetry buffer

primary_user_journeys.action: Deploys a Gemini API key through the KeyDeck panel
primary_user_journeys.expected_observable_outcome: Key validates, is stored in the process, and GET /api/keys/status reports USER_INJECTED

primary_user_journeys.action: Creates, lists and deletes Knowledge Vault entries
primary_user_journeys.expected_observable_outcome: Entries persist in-process and are injected into the next chat turn as CONTEXT FROM VAULT

primary_user_journeys.action: Injects a runtime text skill and lists registered skills
primary_user_journeys.expected_observable_outcome: GET /api/skills lists the injected skill; its guidelines join ACTIVE_CAPABILITIES
POST /api/settings updates that session only; other sessions keep the AGENTS.md default

primary_user_journeys.action: Runs the MOCK_PURGE audit and executes confirmed rewrites
primary_user_journeys.expected_observable_outcome: GET /api/purge/audit lists TODO/mock findings; POST /api/purge/execute rewrites exactly those lines
GET /api/tasks/history returns the rolling 50-record latency/success buffer

primary_user_journeys.action: Performs Google Workspace operations (Sheets/Gmail/Docs) from the browser
primary_user_journeys.expected_observable_outcome: Firebase Google sign-in yields an OAuth token; browser calls Google APIs directly with user confirmation for destructive actions

primary_user_journeys.action: Builds and serves the production bundle
primary_user_journeys.expected_observable_outcome: npm run build emits dist/; NODE_ENV=production npm start serves the SPA at / and the API under /api

in_scope.item: Agent core: engine / orchestrator / memory / registry

out_of_scope.item: Suno audio catalog backend (client-side widget only)
Google Cloud project provisioning / OAuth app verification

architecture_ascii:
+--------------------------- BROWSER (untrusted zone) ---------------------------+
  React 19 dashboard  src/App.tsx (1186 LOC)
    |  ProfileStudio | SunoWidget | WorkspaceWidget | GuestbookWidget | TechStackGrid
    |  ArcadeCabinetWidget(chat) | SystemStatusMonitor | KeyDeck | TaskTracker | KnowledgeVault
    |  localStorage: reddy_chat_logs, reddy_system_instruction, guestbook_signatures
    |
    |  relative fetch('/api/...')                 | direct fetch() + Bearer <OAuth token>
    v                                             v
+---------------------- EXPRESS (trusted zone) ----------------+   +-- Google APIs --+
  server.ts (310 LOC, 14 routes, NO AUTHN/AUTHZ)                |   | Drive/Sheets    |
   /api/chat /api/skills{,/inject} /api/settings                |   | Gmail (send)    |
   /api/knowledge{,/:id} /api/keys{validate,save,status}        |   | Docs            |
   /api/tasks/history /api/purge/audit /api/purge/execute       |   +-----------------+
   |                       |                      |             |
   v                       v                      v             |
 RedAeyeEngine        ToolRegistry           MemoryVault        |
 core/engine.ts       core/registry.ts       core/memory.ts     |
 5-iteration cap      skills+tools maps      50-msg window      |
   |                                                              |
   v                                                              |
 ProviderOrchestrator core/orchestrator.ts ---- HTTPS -----------> Gemini API
   key: customKey || GEMINI_API_KEY                model pinned: gemini-1.5-flash
   POST /api/purge/execute --fs.writeFileSync--> filesystem under process.cwd()
+
  Firebase Auth (browser only) -- src/lib/firebase.ts, 8 OAuth scopes
